technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with short-term bullish RSI and trend indicators offset by price below key moving averages and weak trend strength (ADX 20.65); moderate confluence but lacks conviction for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: CMI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 82 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 13) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional activity and news data limits conviction; neutral AAII sentiment (24% bullish, 49% bearish) suggests capitulation phase.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (430.88), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent CPI event create severely adverse macro conditions despite distant earnings (82 days).

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 bullish, Supertrend bullish, and PSAR bullish with extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) create a contrarian accumulation opportunity near support (176.164) for mean-reversion traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages (EMA 50, SMA 50, SMA 200, Ichimoku cloud), ADX weak (20.65), macro environment in crisis (VIX 430.88, rising USD, flat yield curve), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings risk in 82 days make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI 9 and Supertrend show short-term bullish momentum at support (176.164) in extreme fear environment, offering contrarian setup. However, price remains trapped below all major moving averages with weak trend strength (ADX 20.65), zero fundamental conviction, and macro crisis conditions that outweigh tactical signals.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment in VIX crisis (430.88) with rising USD and flat yield curve creates systemic headwind; price below all key MAs suggests structural weakness despite short-term momentum, risking rapid reversal below support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical shows mixed signals but overwhelmed by fundamental weakness, sentiment contrarian but unconfirmed, and macro crisis regime
decision.portfolio_note: Already 22 positions in Industrials sector (15% of portfolio); adding CMI increases concentration risk without offsetting conviction or fundamental support.
